parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence is documented; same-sex conduct was decriminalised (2012, per the 2024 submission), and the 2016 report's contrary snapshot is dated. Positive signals: police escorts Pride annually, the sole LGBTI organisation operates freely in all districts with a good police relationship, and a workplace discrimination clause exists. Negative signals: no legal gender recognition (a resident gap, but the 2017 analysis flags a possible charge for passport/presentation mismatch — an open question, not a documented enforcement practice), no general non-discrimination statute covering gender identity, documented societal discrimination, undated rape/assault reports, and health-service barriers. No universal-exposure measure (facilities, custody, screening) is documented either way; no organised targeting. Thin-to-moderate data with structural acceptance signals plus stigma places this in Reduced Risk, a step below acceptance-with-protections.
